newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's Samper to attend Hong Kong handover.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Samper to attend Hong Kong handover.

text.p: Colombian President Ernesto Samper will attend next week's ceremony in Hong Kong marking the end of 156 years of British colonial rule over the island, the presidential palace said on Tuesday.
It said Samper had been invited to attend the ceremony, which will take place at the stroke of midnight on June 30, as chairman of the Non-Aligned Movement.

The Colombian leader -- whose U.S. travel visa was revoked last year because of his alleged ties to drug lords -- has also been invited to attend a banquet offered by Britain's Prince Charles aboard the royal yacht Britannia in Hong Kong harbour, the palace said.
Following the handover ceremony, Samper will hold talks with U.N. Secretary General Kofi Annan focusing on the Non-Aligned Movement's repeated calls for deep-rooted reforms of the United Nations.
